entities.note: 6x6 box at rows 36-41, cols 11-16: colour-6 border, BLACK(0) inner ring (black = selected) and a 2x2 colour-6 centre; its right side is open (rows 38-39, col 16) where the striped track leaves it; it faces right (+cols)

6x2-px striped segments (colours 1/2 in a 121121 / 211211 pattern) at rows 38-39 starting at col 11 (first segment hidden under the head, second at cols 17-22): the head's arm; it extends by one 6-px segment per ACTION4 and retracts per ACTION3 and carries cargo

solid 4x4 blocks stacked against the right edge of the yellow area at cols 42-45: colour 8 rows 19-22, colour 9 rows 25-28, colour 14 rows 31-34; pushed by the extending track, captured when they cannot be pushed, dragged back when the track retracts, carried when the head moves sideways
yellow(4) 30x30 work area rows 12-41, cols 17-46: the track tip and cargo may not leave it (6-px lattice)

dotted vertical strip at cols 13-14, rows 14-35 (pairs of colour 2 and 3), just above the head: the lane along which the head may move up/down 6 px at a time (head rows 12, 18, 24, 30, 36); no rail = sideways move refused

bottom yellow strip rows 54-63: a copy of the head glyph (colour 6/0, rows 56-61 cols 20-25) followed by striped track carrying blocks 8 (cols 27-30), 14 (33-36), 9 (39-42) at rows 57-60 = the required order of cargo on the playfield track, nearest to the head first
row 53: colour 2 from the left = remaining energy (64 px = 196), colour 3 eats in from the right about 1 px per 3 moves; every ACTION1-4 costs 1 even when refused; click and undo are free

rules.note: EXTEND (the head's facing direction): a new striped segment appears at the head and the existing ones shift 6 px right; refused (still costs 1) if the tip would leave the yellow area

cargo in the path of the advancing tip is pushed 6 px right; cargo that cannot move (against the area's right edge) stays and the segment slides UNDER it = the block is now riding the track (a brief 8-coloured marker flashes on it)
RETRACT: the segment at the head is removed and the rest shift 6 px left; refused if only one segment is left
cargo riding the track is dragged 6 px toward the head with it; cargo that would leave the area is left behind
UP one lattice step: head, its whole track and every cargo on it move 6 px up together, only if a rail dot sits just above the head; cargo that cannot follow blocks the whole move; costs 1
DOWN one lattice step, same conditions; at the start (row 36 = bottom of the rail) there is no rail below so it does nothing but still costs 1
a sideways move without a rail beside the head (above row 12 or below row 36), or an extend/retract that fails, changes nothing and still costs 1 energy (same for ACTION2/3/4)
clicking selects a head, but L1 has only one selectable head (and its reference copy), so nothing changes; free
UNDO: head, track length and cargo return to where they were before the last move; free, energy not refunded

goal.note: the cargo riding the playfield track, read from the head outward, must have colours 8, 14, 9 = the order shown next to the reference head at the bottom (checked after every move; extra cargo beyond the third is ignored); matched blocks flash and the level ends; shortest known sequence 16 moves
